about: V2.1b offline retrieval eval set (KARAR-2 embeddings decision). Records are fictional; every query term also appears in another project so a scope leak would show.

records.subject: database
records.text: SQLite is the only database; no Postgres server for the desktop app.

records.subject: testing
records.text: Tests run with python -m unittest, never with uv run.

records.subject: ui
records.text: The window layer is written in QML with a Python bridge.

records.subject: push
records.text: Pushing to main always needs Salih's explicit approval.

records.subject: windows-temp
records.text: On Windows, SQLite WAL sidecar files can block deleting the temp folder after tests.

records.subject: reports
records.text: Salih prefers short reports in Turkish.

records.subject: schema
records.text: The schema version stays at 10; new data goes into extra tables, never ALTER.

records.subject: secrets
records.text: API keys are never stored in memory records.

records.subject: memory-search
records.text: Memory search uses SQLite FTS5 first; embeddings only if measurements show the need.

records.subject: ui-tests
records.text: UI tests must run on the system Python, otherwise Qt plugins fail to load.

records.subject: weather
records.text: Hava durumu kartı Beşiktaş için varsayılan konumu kullanır.

records.subject: dashboard
records.text: Eski gösterge paneli emekli edildi; yerine konveyör betiği kullanılıyor.

records.subject: lockfile
records.text: uv.lock dosyasına asla dokunulmaz ve commit edilmez.

records.subject: shortcuts
records.text: Ctrl+Space opens the quick command palette.

records.subject: database
records.text: The shop uses PostgreSQL 16 as its production database.

records.subject: testing
records.text: Backend tests run with pytest and a throwaway Postgres container.

records.subject: hosting
records.text: Deployments go to Fly.io from the release branch.

records.subject: payments
records.text: Payments are handled by Stripe Checkout; the shop never stores card data.

records.subject: caching
records.text: Caching product pages for longer than five minutes showed stale prices.

records.subject: frontend
records.text: Frontend code uses TypeScript strict mode and Tailwind.

records.subject: branding
records.text: Primary brand colour is deep green; buttons use rounded corners.

records.subject: push
records.text: Main branch is protected; merges need one review.

records.subject: product-search
records.text: Product search is backed by Meilisearch, synced every night.

records.subject: migrations
records.text: Run database migrations before deploying the new app version, never after.

records.subject: shipping
records.text: Kargo ücreti 500 TL üzeri siparişlerde ücretsizdir.

records.subject: returns
records.text: İade süresi teslimattan sonra 14 gün olarak belirlendi.

records.subject: email
records.text: Order confirmation emails are sent through Postmark.

records.subject: topic
records.text: The thesis studies retrieval quality of small language models on Turkish text.

records.subject: tracking
records.text: Experiments are tracked in a SQLite database next to the notebooks.

records.subject: citations
records.text: Citations use APA 7 style via Zotero.

records.subject: deadline
records.text: Tez teslim tarihi Haziran sonudur.

records.subject: gpu
records.text: Training on the laptop GPU ran out of memory above batch size 16.

records.subject: writing
records.text: The advisor prefers short paragraphs and active voice.

records.subject: dataset
records.text: The evaluation set has 2000 Turkish questions with gold passages.

records.subject: metrics
records.text: Recall at 10 and MRR are the main retrieval metrics.

records.subject: backups
records.text: Her hafta notebook klasörü harici diske yedeklenir.

records.subject: tokenizer
records.text: Turkish suffixes hurt keyword search; stemming improved recall.

records.subject: pipeline-tests
records.text: Unit tests for the data pipeline run with pytest.

records.subject: language
records.text: Tez İngilizce yazılacak, özet Türkçe de olacak.

records.subject: meetings
records.text: Danışman toplantıları her salı saat 14:00'te yapılır.
